biological_replicate: Autocorrelations were calculated as the Pearson correlation between pairs of stimulated and unstimulated chromatograms, normalized to z scores, and aggregated across all three replicates using Stouffer’s method.
experimental_design: Here, we apply a combination of quantitative proteomic approaches to describe the effects of IFN signaling on the human proteome, and apply protein correlation profiling to map IFN-induced rearrangements in the human protein-protein interaction network.
factor_value: control (light), 4 h IFNβ stimulation (medium), and 24 h IFNβ stimulation (heavy)
For shotgun proteomic analysis, ~ 1.0 × 107 cells were harvested from control (light), 4 h IFNβ stimulation (medium), and 24 h IFNβ stimulation (heavy).
number_of_biological_replicates: Autocorrelations were calculated as the Pearson correlation between pairs of stimulated and unstimulated chromatograms, normalized to z scores, and aggregated across all three replicates using Stouffer’s method.
number_of_fractions: Samples were collected into 80 fractions by a 1200 Series analytical HPLC (Agilent Technologies) at a flow rate of 0.5 mL/min at 8 °C.
technology_type: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
